name: identifier
requirement: Identifiers and qualified names follow the OCL lexical grammar

name: keywords
requirement: Reserved words are distinguished from identifiers

name: comments-whitespace
requirement: Comments and whitespace do not change expression meaning

name: numeric-literal
requirement: Integer Real and UnlimitedNatural literals are distinguished

name: string-literal
requirement: String literals and escapes follow OCL syntax

name: null-invalid-literal
requirement: Null and invalid literal forms are represented explicitly

name: property-call
requirement: Dot property and operation calls are parsed

name: let-expression
requirement: Let declaration and in body are parsed

name: if-expression
requirement: If then else endif is parsed

name: collection-literal
requirement: Set Bag Sequence OrderedSet and Collection literals are parsed

name: iterator-expression
requirement: Iterator declarations separator and body are parsed

name: iterate-expression
requirement: Iterator accumulator declaration and body are parsed

name: tuple-literal
requirement: Tuple literal parts and optional types are parsed

name: operator-precedence
requirement: Unary multiplicative additive relational equality and Boolean precedence is preserved

name: pre-state
requirement: At-pre syntax is parsed only in applicable contexts

name: source-range
requirement: Every token and parsed expression can be associated with a source range

name: self-binding
requirement: Self has the context classifier type

name: variable-binding
requirement: Variable references resolve in lexical scope

name: shadowing
requirement: Nested bindings follow lexical shadowing rules

name: let-type
requirement: Let initializer conforms to an explicit or inferred variable type

name: if-result-type
requirement: If branches have a common conforming result type

name: property-resolution
requirement: Property calls resolve against the source type and visibility context

name: operation-resolution
requirement: Operation overloads resolve by argument types and conformance

name: attribute-chain
requirement: Each navigation segment is valid for the preceding static type

name: association-end
requirement: Association-end navigation resolves an unambiguous role and result type

name: type-operation
requirement: Type operation classifier arguments are valid classifier values

name: all-instances
requirement: AllInstances is invoked on a classifier value

name: tuple-parts
requirement: Tuple part names are unique and values conform to declared part types

name: enum-resolution
requirement: Enumeration literal belongs to the resolved enumeration

name: collection-common-type
requirement: Collection literal elements have a common conforming element type

name: iterator-source
requirement: Iterator source conforms to a collection type

name: iterator-body
requirement: Predicate iterator bodies conform to Boolean where required

name: iterate-accumulator
requirement: Iterate body conforms to the accumulator type

name: pre-result-scope
requirement: Result and at-pre are available only in applicable operation contexts

name: constraint-context
requirement: Constraint expressions conform to the required context result type

name: tuple-structural-type
requirement: Tuple types are determined structurally by their named part types

name: ordered-iterator-body
requirement: SortedBy keys are comparable and closure bodies return compatible navigation values

name: implicit-collect
requirement: Collection call shorthand is distinguished from explicit iterator syntax and optional USE compatibility

name: value-equality
requirement: Equality follows OCL value and object identity semantics

name: null-semantics
requirement: Null is represented as OclVoid and not Java null

name: invalid-propagation
requirement: Invalid propagates according to the invoked operation semantics

name: four-valued-logic
requirement: Boolean operations follow OCL truth tables including null and invalid

name: lazy-if
requirement: Only the selected if branch is evaluated

name: property-evaluation
requirement: Property navigation reads the current evaluation environment and snapshot

name: association-evaluation
requirement: Association navigation preserves multiplicity ordering and uniqueness semantics

name: dynamic-type
requirement: Runtime type operations use classifier conformance

name: all-instances-snapshot
requirement: AllInstances is evaluated against a defined model and snapshot boundary

name: collection-kind
requirement: Collection evaluation preserves Set Bag Sequence and OrderedSet characteristics

name: quantifier-empty
requirement: Quantifiers have defined results for empty collections

name: collect-flattening
requirement: Collect and collectNested apply their distinct flattening semantics

name: iterator-bindings
requirement: Multiple iterator variables range over the defined binding product

name: pre-state-evaluation
requirement: At-pre reads the pre-state and oclIsNew compares object lifecycles

name: message-trace
requirement: Message expressions require an explicitly defined operation trace

name: invariant
requirement: Classifier invariant has self and Boolean result

name: precondition
requirement: Precondition is checked in the operation pre-state

name: postcondition
requirement: Postcondition may access result and the operation pre-state

name: operation-body
requirement: Operation body result conforms to the operation return type

name: derived-property
requirement: Derived property expression conforms to the property type

name: initial-value
requirement: Initial expression conforms to the initialized property type

name: def
requirement: Additional property or operation definitions have a typed lexical context

name: package-context
requirement: Package context resolves qualified model names

name: syntax-compliance
requirement: Syntax compliance is claimed only for inventoried and verified grammar and well-formedness rules

name: evaluation-compliance
requirement: Evaluation compliance is claimed only for inventoried and verified semantics and library signatures

name: xmi-compliance
requirement: XMI interchange is a separate compliance undertaking

name: all-instances
requirement: Support for allInstances is stated explicitly

name: pre-values-ocl-is-new
requirement: Support for pre-values and oclIsNew is stated explicitly

name: ocl-message
requirement: Support for OclMessage is stated explicitly

name: non-navigable-association
requirement: Navigation over non-navigable association ends is stated explicitly

name: private-protected-access
requirement: Access to private and protected model features is stated explicitly

name: ocl-is-undefined
requirement: Undefined query inherited for the null value
